overview.purpose: Understand guest-operations pain points before the peak season.
overview.scope: Front desk, housekeeping and F&B ordering.

systems.name: Housekeeping tracker
systems.limitations: No real-time view for front desk

systems.name: LagoonPMS (fictional)
systems.notes: Vendor says an API exists — not verified.

processes.name: Room turnover
processes.currentProcess: Supervisor radios front desk when a room is ready.

painPoints.description: Guests wait in lobby because room readiness is unknown.
painPoints.impact: Late check-ins and complaints in peak season
painPoints.desiredOutcome: Front desk sees room status live

requirements.statement: Room-ready status visible to front desk within a minute.
Budget likely under one housekeeping salary per year.

evidence.statement: LagoonPMS publishes a partner API for reservations.

findings.environment: Single resort, mixed spreadsheets and one cloud PMS.

answers.value: General manager decides; owner signs off above budget.
